name: Bar J Ranch
tagline: Cattle and Hay Ranch in Cuyama Valley and source for custom metal work
description: Bar J Ranch is an agritourism farm in 004 Cantelow Rd, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
